speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the position-dependent nature of your spinning sensation and false motion is very specific. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The clinical presentation of sudden, position-dependent vertigo in a 70-year-old woman with presbycusis is classic for this condition. I recommend a Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis.
